move: stars pop in elastic with ray bursts, quote rises, stars shrink out
how: On a cream stage five 110px star cells each hold a burst SVG (eight rays and eight dots arranged radially) beneath an orange star path. From 5% each star, staggered 0.18s, scales from 0 and rotation -40 to full with elastic.out(1,0.45) over 0.6s; at the same instant its rays scale from 0 to 1.6 about the centre and fade (power3.out, 0.5s) and its dots scale 0.3 to 2.2 and fade (power2.out), reading as a firework burst around the landing star. A quote line rises y:30/opacity:0 with expo.out at 38%. Exit at 80%: fills shrink to 0 with back.in(2) staggered 0.06 from the last star, the quote lifts out.
adapt: Change the quote text, star fill (#ff9f1c), ray (#ff6b35) and dot (#ffd166) colours and the ray count in the inner loop; keep the 0.18 stagger with elastic.out(1,0.45) and the simultaneous burst.
port: mount(el, shot) generates the five star cells with burst SVGs and the label into el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with pops at 0.05-0.4 of D, label at 0.38, exit at 0.8. Per-star querySelector calls are already element-scoped; only the initial toArray('.star') must be scoped to el.
caveats: rays and dots use transformOrigin '0 0' inside a centred viewBox, so the SVG viewBox must stay centred on 0,0
stars shrink to nothing at the end; start and end frames match apart from the label
